description: This file defines mock classes for the IControl and IControlFactory interfaces used in the Rialto project, utilizing Google Mock for unit testing.

classes.name: ControlFactoryMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of IControlFactory for testing, providing a mocked createControl method.

classes.name: ControlMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of IControl for testing, providing a mocked registerClient method.

methods.name: createControl
methods.description: Mocked method to create an IControl instance, returns a shared pointer.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Mocked method to register a client with the control, takes a weak pointer to IControlClient and an ApplicationState reference.
